name: @huddle/game-bomb-squad
description: Bomb Squad Game Module: hidden saboteurs, private clues, one wire to cut.
//exports: `./logic` is the rules without the screens, and exists so the Convex server can import them without bundling React Native. A module's screens are properties of it and do not tree-shake, so the seam has to be an entry point rather than a hope about the bundler.
//peerDependencies: Screens only, and for the same reason `@huddle/ui` declares them this way: `react-native` resolves to whichever variant the consuming app installed — react-native-tvos on the TV, stock on the phone. The `./logic` entry point imports none of it, which is what lets the Convex server take the rules without any of this. `@shopify/react-native-skia` is the TV app's copy; the phone app aliases it to a stub (apps/phone/metro.config.js) because only the TV renders this game's Skia art.
